mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO review_score (id, report_id, dimension_key, applicable, score, rationale, evidence, suggestions, display_order) VALUES
(#{s.id}, #{s.reportId}, #{s.dimensionKey}, #{s.applicable}, #{s.score}, #{s.rationale}, #{s.evidence}::jsonb, #{s.suggestions}::jsonb, #{s.displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, dimension_key, applicable, score, rationale, evidence::text AS evidence, suggestions::text AS suggestions, display_order FROM review_score WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY display_order
